notes.title: Game release thanks and tips
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44991050/e7923745314823b1217322aac3275978722f032f.jpg[/img]
Thank you to the players who made the initial purchase and support. There were many issues during the first week of the game's launch, but we will humbly collect feedback and suggestions from each player, and make every effort to update and maintain it as soon as possible. We also release some tips, hoping to improve your gaming experience.

Travel suggestions
During the gameplay, try to kill enemies on the road as much as possible, which can provide important resources for learning skills.
2. Try to learn various skills as much as possible, especially those in the Underworld Technique, which can improve the combat tolerance rate.
3. The game features a multi branch replacement storyline, and the enemies encountered may change, so there are fewer automatic saves. It is strongly recommended to use more save points for saving.
4. It is strongly recommended to use a controller for gameplay, as it can provide a better combat feel.

matters needing attention
1. Currently, the game performance consumption is relatively high. Try to use the default resolution below 1080P when playing, as there may be frame drops above 2K.
2. Reducing shadow and texture settings and turning off UI may result in some key information UI or effects being blocked, affecting the combat experience. It is strongly recommended to default.
3. Currently, when fighting against the BOSS, the BOSS is located below the character, which can easily cause blind spots in the field of view. It is advisable to adjust the position of the BOSS as much as possible.
4. Some non XBOX controllers may have conflicts with keyboard operations. The solution is to keep the controller plugged in and restart Steam to start the game, or to fully control the keyboard and mouse during the initial unplugged state of the controller. Choose one of the two.
5. The above precautions will be optimized as soon as possible. Thank you again.


There will also be an updated schedule for the next six months in the near future, and we will also provide activity benefits from time to time. Please stay tuned.

notes.title: Initial pricing discount consultation
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44991050/da4403f93bd551f28fe55ef520a7e24a5c6fa9bc.jpg[/img]
Our pricing has been announced.

Today we would like to share with you an overview of the launch of this game, including game content, initial pricing, and the fact that "Liuyin Jiujue" is a spin off sequel to the world view of Kingna Studio's first work "Liuyin". It tells the story of the protagonist searching for ancient artifacts to rescue the people.
The complete version of the game includes 7 major levels, several small secret realms, and 20 bosses. The single process takes about 5-7 hours, and the game has 3 endings corresponding to the final bosses of the 3 major branches.

In terms of level plot, we have adopted a multi branch structure, where different game strategy choices will lead to changes in the subsequent plot and bosses, ultimately resulting in different storylines.
In terms of combat system, the game focuses on a fast-paced mode of attack and defense transition. In addition to conventional combat methods such as blade fighting, blocking, and dodging, it also adds special combat modes such as wall shaking. Paired with three sets of martial arts and skills that can be combined to form one's own combat style, collecting multiple rounds can experience more fun of martial arts combinations.

The game is expected to be unlocked on August 2, 2024, with a national price of 68 yuan and a 12% discount on the first release. It can be stored for 59.84 yuan.
If the game is a bit to your taste, you can try the trial version or add it to your wishlist. Thank you again for your attention and support, players.

notes.title: May 25, 2024 demo update for trial play
notes.notes:
Update instructions
Thank you all for your trial experience. We have received many enthusiastic comments so far. Thank you very much for your feedback, and we will continue to make the game better. Thank you.

Optimization and adjustment
1. Configure martial arts, perception skills, etc. to exit or die while maintaining the previous settings.
2. Optimize the speed of novice guided reading.
3. The combat feel of unparalleled skills.
4. Adjust the protagonist's initial speed to running, and normal interaction will no longer switch to a slow walking posture.
5. Optimize the priority of the perception skill interface to make the release of skills flexible and smooth.
6. Add some map interaction elements. 
7. Optimize the AI of teaching enemies to make them more meaningful in teaching.
Bug repair
1. Fix some interaction bugs within the map.
2. Fix and delete back stab collisions of giant rock monsters in unknown secret realms.
3. Fix some UI description errors.

Partial Description
At present, some players have reported that the curved screen resolution (21:9) cannot fully display the UI. Currently, the in-game or display resolution can be modified to (16:9) 2560 * 14401920 * 10801280 * 720 window mode to play the game. We will also intensify the adaptation of special displays. Thank you.
